phases.title: Plugin Simplification: Less is More
phases.goal: Reduce plugin surface to core plan/work/review flow. Remove unused skills, merge release-engine into local project, internalize ralph-loop, combine session+maintenance. Result: smaller plugin focused on Harness core; release tooling owned by host project.

tasks.name: Remove breezing skill
tasks.description: Delete harness/skills/breezing/ — it is only an alias for harness-work --breezing. Update any references (skill catalog, CLAUDE.md, marketplace.json) to point users to '/harness-work --breezing' instead.
tasks.dod: Directory harness/skills/breezing/ removed; no remaining references in marketplace.json, docs/CLAUDE-skill-catalog.md, CLAUDE.md, or other skills; bash tests/validate-plugin.sh passes.

tasks.name: Convert harness-guide skill to reference doc
tasks.description: Move harness/skills/harness-guide/SKILL.md content into harness/references/guide.md (or docs/). Delete the skill directory. Update marketplace.json and skill catalog to drop the entry. Anywhere a skill linked to harness-guide, replace with a doc link.
tasks.dod: harness/skills/harness-guide/ removed; content preserved at harness/references/guide.md; no broken links in docs or skills; validate-plugin.sh passes.

tasks.name: Remove harness-schedule-run skill
tasks.description: Delete harness/skills/harness-schedule-run/. Claude Code's native /loop handles iterative review-work runs. Update marketplace.json, skill catalog, and any cross-references in harness-work or harness-review.
tasks.dod: harness/skills/harness-schedule-run/ removed; no references remain; CHANGELOG note mentions /loop as the replacement; validate-plugin.sh passes.

tasks.name: Merge harness-releaser agent into .claude/agents/releaser.md
tasks.description: Move harness/agents/harness-releaser.md content into .claude/agents/releaser.md. Update release-this SKILL.md to invoke 'releaser' (local agent) instead of 'harness-releaser' (plugin agent). Remove from marketplace.json agents list.
tasks.dod: .claude/agents/releaser.md exists with full setup/finalize invocation contract; release-this references the local agent; harness/agents/harness-releaser.md removed; agent dispatches correctly under /release-this --dry-run.

tasks.name: Merge harness-release skill into .claude/skills/release-this
tasks.description: Inline the generic release-engine content from harness/skills/harness-release/ into .claude/skills/release-this/ (this project's local release skill). Copy supporting scripts (release-preflight.sh, sync-version.sh, validate-release-notes.sh, check-residue.py, bench-residue.sh) under .claude/skills/release-this/scripts/. Update release-this SKILL.md to do all phases directly (preflight, version bump, CHANGELOG, commit, tag, push, GitHub release) instead of delegating. Delete harness/skills/harness-release/.
tasks.dod: harness/skills/harness-release/ removed; .claude/skills/release-this/ self-contained with all scripts and references; /release-this patch --dry-run completes successfully end-to-end; no marketplace.json references to harness-release.

tasks.name: Internalize harness-ralph-loop and ralph-worker
tasks.description: Remove harness-ralph-loop from the user-facing slash palette (drop from marketplace.json skills list and skill catalog). Keep the SKILL.md and ralph-worker.md files intact but mark them internal (user-invocable: false in frontmatter). harness-work continues to dispatch to it for tasks with [ralph] marker, as today.
tasks.dod: harness-ralph-loop no longer in marketplace.json public skills; user-invocable: false set; harness-work dispatch still functional for [ralph] tasks; integration test with a sample [ralph] task verifies dispatch works.

tasks.name: Combine session and maintenance skills
tasks.description: Merge harness/skills/session/ content into harness/skills/maintenance/ (or whichever survives). Pick the broader name 'maintenance' and absorb session-specific operations as subcommands or references. Update CLAUDE.md, skill catalog, and any cross-skill references.
tasks.dod: Only one of session/ or maintenance/ remains as the unified skill; all subcommands documented in the SKILL.md; no references to the removed skill; validate-plugin.sh passes.

tasks.name: Validate plugin and update marketplace.json
tasks.description: After all removals/merges, refresh marketplace.json to reflect the new skill/agent inventory. Run full validation: bash tests/validate-plugin.sh, bash .claude/skills/release-this/scripts/check-consistency.sh, and harness plan-cli serve --open to spot check the kanban. Bump VERSION as a major change in a release PR (separate from this task).
tasks.dod: marketplace.json lists only the surviving skills/agents; validate-plugin.sh passes; check-consistency.sh passes; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section drafted with removal/merge notes; ready to /release-this major.
